Functions.Name: Scl_LibertyItem
Functions.Original: static inline Scl_Item_t *  Scl_LibertyItem( Scl_Tree_t * p, int v )                               { assert( v < p->nItems ); return v < 0 ? NULL : p->pItems + v;     }

Functions.Name: Scl_LibertyCompare
Functions.Original: static inline int           Scl_LibertyCompare( Scl_Tree_t * p, Scl_Pair_t Pair, char * pStr )     { return strncmp( p->pContents+Pair.Beg, pStr, Pair.End-Pair.Beg ) || ((int)strlen(pStr) != Pair.End-Pair.Beg); }
Functions.Draft: func Scl_LibertyCompare(p *Scl_Tree_t, Pair Scl_Pair_t, pStr string) int32 { return strncmp( p.pContents+Pair.Beg, pStr, Pair.End-Pair.Beg ) || (int32(len(pStr)) != Pair.End-Pair.Beg); }

Functions.Name: Scl_PrintWord
Functions.Original: static inline void          Scl_PrintWord( FILE * pFile, Scl_Tree_t * p, Scl_Pair_t Pair )         { char * pBeg = p->pContents+Pair.Beg, * pEnd = p->pContents+Pair.End; while ( pBeg < pEnd ) fputc( *pBeg++, pFile ); }
Functions.Draft:
func Scl_PrintWord(pFile *os.File, p *Scl_Tree_t, Pair Scl_Pair_t) { var pBeg string = p.pContents+Pair.Beg;
var pEnd string = p.pContents+Pair.End; for  pBeg < pEnd  { fputc( *pBeg++, pFile ); } }

Functions.Name: Scl_PrintSpace
Functions.Original: static inline void          Scl_PrintSpace( FILE * pFile, int nOffset )                            { int i; for ( i = 0; i < nOffset; i++ ) fputc(' ', pFile);         }
Functions.Draft: func Scl_PrintSpace(pFile *os.File, nOffset int32) { var i int32; for  i = 0; i < nOffset; i++  { fputc(' ', pFile); }         }

Functions.Name: Scl_LibertyItemId
Functions.Original: static inline int           Scl_LibertyItemId( Scl_Tree_t * p, Scl_Item_t * pItem )                { return pItem - p->pItems;                                         }
Functions.Draft: func Scl_LibertyItemId(p *Scl_Tree_t, pItem *Scl_Item_t) int32 { return pItem - p.pItems;                                         }
